title: Count Good Strings
statement: Given n, the task is to count strings of length n over {a,b} that are good, modulo 1e9+7. A good string is either a single character repeated an odd number of times, or the concatenation of two good strings whose boundary characters differ. Equivalently, every maximal run has odd length. n can be up to 10^15, so the Fibonacci-like recurrence needs logarithmic-time evaluation.
